hook.en: A large company may have lakhs of shareholders, yet it can sign contracts, own factories and go to court in its own name. How can a business be a person in law?
hook.kn: ದೊಡ್ಡ ಕಂಪನಿಗೆ ಲಕ್ಷಾಂತರ ಷೇರುದಾರರಿರಬಹುದು, ಆದರೂ ಅದು ತನ್ನದೇ ಹೆಸರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಪ್ಪಂದ ಮಾಡಿ, ಕಾರ್ಖಾನೆ ಹೊಂದಿ, ನ್ಯಾಯಾಲಯಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಗಬಹುದು. ವ್ಯವಹಾರವೊಂದು ಕಾನೂನಿನಲ್ಲಿ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯಾಗುವುದು ಹೇಗೆ?

objectives.en: State the features of a joint stock company
Distinguish private, public and one person companies

narration.en: A large company may have lakhs of shareholders, yet it can sign contracts, own factories and go to court in its own name. How can a business be a person in law?
narration.kn: ದೊಡ್ಡ ಕಂಪನಿಗೆ ಲಕ್ಷಾಂತರ ಷೇರುದಾರರಿರಬಹುದು, ಆದರೂ ಅದು ತನ್ನದೇ ಹೆಸರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಪ್ಪಂದ ಮಾಡಿ, ಕಾರ್ಖಾನೆ ಹೊಂದಿ, ನ್ಯಾಯಾಲಯಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಗಬಹುದು. ವ್ಯವಹಾರವೊಂದು ಕಾನೂನಿನಲ್ಲಿ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯಾಗುವುದು ಹೇಗೆ?

body.en: A company is an association of persons formed for carrying on business, with a separate legal entity, limited liability and perpetual succession. It is an artificial person created by law under the Companies Act, 2013, managed by an elected board of directors, and its formation is lengthy and costly. The common seal, once compulsory, is now optional.

points.en: Artificial person and separate legal entity

narration.en: A company is an association of persons formed for carrying on business, with a separate legal entity, limited liability and perpetual succession. It is an artificial person created by law under the Companies Act, 2013, managed by an elected board of directors, and its formation is lengthy and costly. The common seal, once compulsory, is now optional.
narration.kn: ಕಂಪನಿ ಕಾನೂನಿನಿಂದ ರಚಿತವಾದ ಕೃತಕ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ. ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ಕಾನೂನು ಅಸ್ತಿತ್ವ, ಸೀಮಿತ ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಶಾಶ್ವತ ಉತ್ತರಾಧಿಕಾರ ಇದರ ಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳು.

body.en: Merits are limited liability, transfer of interest, perpetual existence, scope for expansion and professional management; limitations are complex formation, lack of secrecy, an impersonal work environment, many regulations and delays in decisions. A private company has 2 to 200 members, restricts share transfer and cannot invite the public; a public company has at least 7 members with no maximum and its shares are freely transferable. A One Person Company has a single member.

points.en: Public: at least 7 members, at least 3 directors

narration.kn: ಖಾಸಗಿ ಕಂಪನಿಗೆ 2ರಿಂದ 200 ಸದಸ್ಯರು; ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ ಕಂಪನಿಗೆ ಕನಿಷ್ಠ 7 ಸದಸ್ಯರು, ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ಮಿತಿ ಇಲ್ಲ; ಏಕವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ಕಂಪನಿಗೆ ಒಬ್ಬನೇ ಸದಸ್ಯ.

problem.en: Rohit holds 1,000 shares of ₹10 each in a public company, on which ₹6 per share has been paid. The company goes into liquidation with heavy debts. What is the most Rohit can be asked to pay?

steps.en: Face value per share = ₹10; paid = ₹6; unpaid = ₹4 per share.
Liability is limited to the unpaid amount; his personal property is safe.

narration.en: Let us work through this case together. Rohit holds 1,000 shares of ₹10 each in a public company, on which ₹6 per share has been paid. The company goes into liquidation with heavy debts. What is the most Rohit can be asked to pay?
Team quiz. Each team discusses for a moment and gives one answer.
narration.kn: ತಂಡ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ತಂಡ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ ಒಂದು ಉತ್ತರ ನೀಡಲಿ.

points.en: A company is an artificial person with a separate legal entity.
points.kn: ಕಂಪನಿ ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ಕಾನೂನು ಅಸ್ತಿತ್ವವಿರುವ ಕೃತಕ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ.

points.en: Shareholders' liability is limited; the company has perpetual succession.
points.kn: ಷೇರುದಾರರ ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆ ಸೀಮಿತ; ಕಂಪನಿಗೆ ಶಾಶ್ವತ ಉತ್ತರಾಧಿಕಾರ.

points.en: Private company: 2–200 members; public company: minimum 7.
points.kn: ಖಾಸಗಿ ಕಂಪನಿ: 2–200 ಸದಸ್ಯರು; ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ ಕಂಪನಿ: ಕನಿಷ್ಠ 7.

points.en: Formation is lengthy and the company is closely regulated.
points.kn: ರಚನೆ ದೀರ್ಘ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ; ಕಂಪನಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣಕ್ಕೆ ಒಳಪಟ್ಟಿದೆ.

homework.en: Distinguish between a private company and a public company on five points.

narration.en: Recap. A company is an artificial person with a separate legal entity. Shareholders' liability is limited; the company has perpetual succession. Private company: 2–200 members; public company: minimum 7. Formation is lengthy and the company is closely regulated.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಕಂಪನಿ ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ಕಾನೂನು ಅಸ್ತಿತ್ವವಿರುವ ಕೃತಕ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ. ಷೇರುದಾರರ ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆ ಸೀಮಿತ; ಕಂಪನಿಗೆ ಶಾಶ್ವತ ಉತ್ತರಾಧಿಕಾರ. ಖಾಸಗಿ ಕಂಪನಿ: 2–200 ಸದಸ್ಯರು; ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ ಕಂಪನಿ: ಕನಿಷ್ಠ 7. ರಚನೆ ದೀರ್ಘ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ; ಕಂಪನಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣಕ್ಕೆ ಒಳಪಟ್ಟಿದೆ.
